description:
Activate Vault of Catlacan by tapping it, adding at least {U}{U}{U}{U}.
Activate Candelabra of Tawnos by paying {1} and tapping it, untapping Vault of Catlacan.

Cast Candelabra of Tawnos by paying {1}.
